lexpilot-proactive-legal-clarification.gallerySummary: Ask for missing case facts before predicting legal claims. Evaluated in Chinese civil consultation, not streaming perception.

figure.alt: LexPilot comparison of direct prediction and proactive fact elicitation

properagent-memory-driven-proactivity.gallerySummary: Retrieve personal memories, gate whether they justify an interruption, then deliver a timely reminder—or stay silent. Includes windowed and streaming implementations.

figure.alt: ProPerAgent Figure 1 comparing reactive answers and memory-driven proactive reminders

release.detail: Paper promises code and the ProPerMem evaluation set upon publication; no linked public release was verified.

proactgen-video-clarification.gallerySummary: Use generated visual evidence to decide which missing preference to clarify before refining a video-generation prompt. Not a streaming assistant.

figure.alt: ProactGen overview contrasting prompt rewriting with proactive preference clarification

safe-pro-cross-modal-inquiry.gallerySummary: Detect a safety-critical missing premise across image and text, then ask a targeted clarification rather than guessing the user's intent.

figure.alt: SAFE-PRO Figure 1 showing implicit reasoning risk and intent-level ambiguity

surgstreamer-request-driven-monitoring.gallerySummary: Convert a 1-FPS surgical stream into structured tool, action and phase state. Rules or a pointer controller trigger a standing request; this is not autonomous clinical need discovery.

figure.alt: SurgStreamer Figure 1 walkthrough of request-conditioned event detection and alert timing

release.detail: New code, benchmark definitions, splits and protocol history are promised upon publication. Public source videos are not a release of this pipeline.

p3i-proactive-video-assistants.gallerySummary: Evaluate perception, hazard prediction and intervention with content-plus-timing scores and redundant-response penalties. SFT + RL trains a Qwen3-VL-4B response/silence policy.

figure.alt: P3IBench overview of perception, prediction and intervention capabilities

release.detail: Inference/evaluation scripts and ungated benchmark JSON/video files are public. No P3I-Assistant-4B checkpoint or training pipeline was verified in the linked repositories.

pam-proactive-robot-assistance.gallerySummary: A finite-state memory of personal routines guides a VLM's task/NO_ACT choice; a VLA executes. Daily reflection edits the memory, not model weights.

figure.alt: PAM overview of task prediction, VLA execution and procedural memory reflection

release.detail: Linked repository is reachable but contains project-page assets, demos, an example FSM and helper tools—not the complete robot implementation or an evaluation dataset.

masp-proactive-dialogue-self-play.gallerySummary: Mentalized adversarial self-play trains proactive dialogue policies against more challenging users, rather than only cooperative simulated users.

figure.alt: MASP mentalizer training, behavior cloning and alternating self-play framework

attrify-soft-attribute-clarification.gallerySummary: Clarification turns subjective attributes such as originality into executable criteria that better match a user's intended meaning.

duplexact-content-grounded-interruption.gallerySummary: The Help/Safety Interrupt subset tests taking the floor with useful help or warnings. The entire full-duplex benchmark is not a proactive-assistance benchmark.

streamingjev-proactive-physical-ai.gallerySummary: Separate a streaming timing gate from an asynchronous response model. Both observe continuously; a gate opens speech or typed device calls without stopping observation.

figure.alt: ProAgent architecture with StreamingJev timing model, response model and device execution feedback

release.detail: No public implementation, StreamingJev weights or new training-data release was verified from the paper's linked resources. Evaluation on public benchmarks is not a new data release.

uncertainty-proactive-assistant-alignmen.gallerySummary: Use uncertainty about user preferences to calibrate proactive assistance; a personalization and alignment perspective, not a streaming model.

reqclarifybench-repository-requirements.gallerySummary: Evaluate whether coding agents ask for missing requirements rather than silently guessing during repository-level software development.

egovoice-proactive-spoken-assistance.gallerySummary: Train MiniCPM-o 4.5 to choose Listen or Speak on egocentric audio/video. SFT + DPO refines timing and restraint under a supplied task recipe.

figure.alt: EgoVoice first-person multimodal stream, silence or intervention decision and spoken guidance

release.detail: Official project page schedules code, models and data for November 2026. A base-model release is not an EgoVoice checkpoint release.

cleat-value-guided-clarification.gallerySummary: Learn when clarification is worth its interaction cost, using value-guided decisions rather than a fixed ask-first rule.
